data.name: Tejnarayan
data.short_meaning: God of Power and Tej, meaning radiance, brilliance or splendor
data.long_meaning: Tej refers to radiance, brilliance or splendor, while Narayan is the name of Vishnu, the preserver deity in Hinduism. The name Tejnarayan thus signifies the deity of power and radiance, and is a powerful and auspicious name for a boy.
data.spiritual_meaning: Tejnarayan is a spiritual name that embodies the qualities of power, strength, and light. It is believed to bring blessings of prosperity, success, and good fortune to the bearer of this name.
data.numerology_meaning: The name Tejnarayan is a 7 and 5 name in numerology. The number 7 represents spiritual growth and development, while the number 5 represents change and adaptability. This combination of energies suggests that the bearer of this name is a spiritual seeker who is adaptable and open to new experiences.

in_sanskrit.name: तेजनारायण
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Tej (बल्वान्) meaning power or strength, and Nara (मनुष्य) meaning man, and Rāyaṇ (राज्य) meaning kingdom or rule. So Tejnarayan means God of Wisdom and Wealth, the one who rules over wisdom and wealth.

in_hindi.name: तेजनारायण
in_hindi.long_meaning: Tej (शक्ति) meaning power or strength, and Nara (मनुष्य) meaning man, and Rāyaṇ (राज्य) meaning kingdom or rule. So Tejnarayan in Hindi means God of Wisdom and Wealth, the one who is full of power and is worthy of worship.

in_tamil.name: தேஜ்னாராயண்
in_tamil.long_meaning: Tej (விஜயம்) meaning power or strength, and Nārāyaṇ (அருள்வான்) meaning the one who is present with us in the form of God Vishnu. So Tejnarayan in Tamil means God of Wisdom and Wealth, the one who is always present with us in the form of God Vishnu.

in_telugu.name: తెజ్ఞానారాయణ
in_telugu.long_meaning: Tej (శక్తి) meaning power or strength, and Nārāyaṇ (దేశియదేశ) meaning the king of kings or the one who is the god of gods. So Tejnarayan in Telugu means God of Wisdom and Wealth, the one who is the king of kings or the one who is the god of gods.

data.cultural_impact: The name Tejnarayan carries deep cultural significance in the Hindu tradition. Vishnu, represented by the name Narayan, is one of the three main gods in Hinduism, alongside Shiva and Brahma. A deity of extensive powers and attributes, Vishnu is revered as the preserver, protector, and sustainer of the universe. The prefix Tej adds to this meaning by acknowledging and revering the God's power, strength, brilliance, and all-encompassing presence.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, Tejnarayan is a Supreme Name that evokes the concept of divine power, majesty, and purity. In Hinduism, the Supreme Godhead is often referred to as Tejometas, or the possessor of Tej or divine power. The name Tejnarayan lies at the intersection of personal and cosmic influences, as it refers to the individual's connection to the supreme Deity's divine power, guiding him on his spiritual path.

They believe their name has guided them on the path of righteousness.

data.spiritual_symbolism: Tej Narayan: God Tej (radiant energy) and Narayan (the supreme deity Vishnu). Together, they symbolize the divine union of radiant energy and divine consciousness.
